---
title: Data Cleaning
format: typst
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
votes <- read_csv("data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec.csv", guess_max = 200000)

clean_headers <- function(headers) {
  headers |>
    str_trim() |>                       
    str_to_lower() |>                    
    str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9_\\s]", "") |>  
    str_replace_all("[-\\s]+", "_")      
}

names(votes) <- clean_headers(names(votes))
names(votes)

votes <- votes |>
  mutate(across(matches("vote|count|tot", ignore.case = TRUE),
                ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", .x))))


votes |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "missing_rate") |>
  arrange(desc(missing_rate)) |>
  head(10)


if ("precinct_id" %in% names(votes)) {
  dup <- votes |> count(precinct_id) |> filter(n > 1)
  if (nrow(dup) > 0) print(head(dup))
} else if ("srprec_key" %in% names(votes)) {
  dup <- votes |> count(srprec_key) |> filter(n > 1)
  if (nrow(dup) > 0) print(head(dup))
}

vote_cols <- names(votes)[which(names(votes) == "assaip01"):which(names(votes) == "ussrep01")]

votes <- votes |>
  mutate(across(all_of(vote_cols), ~ as.integer(replace_na(.x, 0))))

write_csv(votes, "data/g24_sov_by_g24_svprec_clean.csv")

```


# Part 5: Re-running the 2024 Election
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
TARGET_CRS <- 3310

votes_srprec <- read_csv("data/state_g24_sov_data_by_g24_srprec.csv")

srprec_shp <- st_read("data/shapefiles/srprec_state_g24_v01_shp/srprec_state_g24_v01_shp.shp")

vote_cols_sr <- c('PRSDEM01', 'PRSREP01')

votes_srprec <- votes_srprec |>
  mutate(across(all_of(vote_cols_sr), ~ as.integer(replace_na(.x, 0)))) |>
  select(SRPREC_KEY, all_of(vote_cols_sr))


srprec_gdf <- srprec_shp |>
  left_join(votes_srprec, by = "SRPREC_KEY") |>
  filter(if_all(all_of(vote_cols_sr), ~ .x != 0 | is.na(.x) == FALSE))

ab604_gdf <- st_read("data/AB604.shp")

srprec_gdf <- srprec_gdf |>
  st_transform(crs = TARGET_CRS) |>
  st_set_precision(1) |>
  st_make_valid() |>  
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |>
  mutate(original_area = st_area(geometry))

ab604_gdf <- ab604_gdf |>
  st_transform(crs = TARGET_CRS)

intersection <- st_intersection(
  srprec_gdf |>
     select(SRPREC_KEY, PRSDEM01, PRSREP01, original_area),
  ab604_gdf |>
     select(DISTRICT)
)

intersection <- intersection |>
  mutate(
    intersect_area = st_area(geometry),
    area_ratio = units::drop_units(intersect_area / original_area)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    DEM_ALLOCATED = PRSDEM01 * area_ratio,
    REP_ALLOCATED = PRSREP01 * area_ratio
  )

final_results <- intersection |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  group_by(DISTRICT) |>
  summarise(
    DEM_VOTES = sum(DEM_ALLOCATED, na.rm = TRUE),
    REP_VOTES = sum(REP_ALLOCATED, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    TOTAL_VOTES = DEM_VOTES + REP_VOTES,
    DEM_SHARE = DEM_VOTES / TOTAL_VOTES,
    DISTRICT = as.integer(DISTRICT)
  ) |>
  arrange(DISTRICT)

print(head(final_results))
write_csv(final_results, "ab604_results.csv")

```
